annotations.title: Generate GSA MAS Schedule SIN Mapping, 0.75% IFF Rate Card & PRC Compliance Package

description: Map commercial labor rate cards, software/cloud SKUs, commercial discounting practices, and past project histories into a GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS) Large Category F (IT) eOffer or eMod package containing a Special Item Number (SIN) mapping matrix (`54151S`, `54151HACS`, `518210C`, `511210`, `OLM`), a GSA Price Proposal Template (PPT) ceiling rate card grossed up for the 0.75% Industrial Funding Fee (`Net / 0.9925`) with 5-year GSAR 552.238-118 EPA escalation, GSAR 552.238-81 Price Reductions Clause (PRC) / Most Favored Customer (MFC) guardrails, CSP-1 vs. Transactional Data Reporting (TDR) pathway recommendations, and a ready-to-submit SCP-FSS-001 proposal narrative. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive compliance and pricing generator (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `commercial_catalog_and_lcat_rates` accepts 20 to 45,000 characters and `corporate_experience_and_project_context` accepts 20 to 35,000 characters). Use this tool when preparing a GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS) eOffer, SIN addition eMod, or GSAR 552.238-81 Price Reductions Clause (PRC) / MFC audit; use `generate_igce_price_to_win` instead for single-RFP IGCE wrap-rate and Price-to-Win modeling, or `match_key_personnel` to tailor individual candidate resumes to LCAT minimums.

commercial_catalog_and_lcat_rates.description: Commercial Price List (CPL), LCAT titles, hourly rates, minimum education/years of experience, software/SaaS SKUs, and standard commercial discounting practices (20 to 45,000 characters).

corporate_experience_and_project_context.description: Past project experience for SCP-FSS-001 Factor 4 (1-2 completed projects per target SIN), target GSA IT/Cyber SINs (`54151S`, `54151HACS`, `518210C`), and commercial customer classes (20 to 35,000 characters).

pricing_disclosure_pathway.description: GSA MAS pricing disclosure pathway: 'CSP-1_Traditional_PRC' (traditional Commercial Sales Practices with Most Favored Customer tracking), 'TDR_Transactional_Data_Reporting' (GSAR 552.238-81 Alt I TDR exemption), or 'Auto_Recommend' (default).

submission_type.description: Submission mode: 'New_GSA_MAS_Offer' (default, full SCP-FSS-001 eOffer package) or 'Add_SIN_or_EPA_Price_Mod' (GSA eMod SIN addition or GSAR 552.238-118 Economic Price Adjustment).

name: generate_gsa_mas_offer

gsa_lcat_iff_price_list.description: GSA Price Proposal Template (PPT) rate card with CPL, Net, 0.75% IFF ceiling rate, and 5-year EPA progression.

gsa_mas_readiness_score.description: Overall GSA eOffer / eMod readiness score from 0 to 100.

iff_and_epa_pricing_summary.description: Summary of 0.75% Industrial Funding Fee (`Net / 0.9925`) calculation and 5-year EPA escalation.

prc_and_mfc_compliance_guardrails.description: GSAR 552.238-81 Price Reductions Clause (PRC) and Most Favored Customer (MFC) safe-harbor guardrails.

ready_to_submit_scp_fss_001_narrative.description: Paste-ready SCP-FSS-001 Administrative, Technical, and Price Proposal narrative for GSA eOffer / eMod.

recommended_pricing_pathway.description: Recommended GSA pricing disclosure regime (TDR vs. CSP-1 MFC) and rationale.

sin_mapping_matrix.description: Mapped GSA MAS SINs (`54151S`, `54151HACS`, `518210C`, `OLM`) with Factor 4 project narratives.

title: Generate GSA MAS Schedule SIN Mapping, 0.75% IFF Rate Card & PRC Compliance Package
